My name is John Cambareri, and I am a graduate student at the University of Idaho. I am currently working on a research project revolving around UI research grants and expenditures, and whether participation in a university cohort significantly increases their funding.

If I am not currently working, I will usually be spending time playing video games, listening to music, or playing pinball. Alternatively, I could have either of my two cats, Sasha or Rex, on my lap.
